ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark) with approximately 5-8% high-intensity (white/grey) pixel coverage on the visible fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant contiguous black region across both lobes. Stochastic distribution of small white/light-grey circular pixel blobs (mottling) throughout. Concentrated high-intensity clusters at distal lobe tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Visible shallow V-shaped depression at central junction; estimated obtuse angle with low depth-to-width ratio.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous irregular trailing boundary with frequent low-amplitude peaks; serration frequency increases significantly toward the distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetric convex upward curve following a parabolic trajectory from the median notch to the outer tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense, roughly circular high-contrast pixel clusters (rosettes) localized at the extreme distal tips of both lobes. Scattered individual white pixel points across the main surface body.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive accumulation of light-colored, irregular pixel clusters at distal tips, resulting in altered geometric contours compared to smooth lobe edges.
